source_state: uncommitted position-local masked readout, portable geometry/trace descriptor and selected Metal allocation facts
behavior: The existing independent scalar contract is position-local. Native minimum now reduces only selected vocabulary, so batch and sequence partitions preserve masked scores.

Shared portable geometry rejects empty feature/vocabulary/centroid axes, invalid ranks, exact-shape mismatches and invalid selection/margin. Empty batch/sequence axes return F32 empty output before native sort or reduction. Scalar geometry uses checked products.

The metadata tensor traces the ordinary masked-output primitive. Metal facts retain full partition backing and actual selected-weight replicas per position, dense products and their possible casts/copies, per-position minimum and F32 fill/scatter. All child allocations are retained conservatively through completion; disjoint host payload is explicitly zero.

Native fixtures cover all-centroid selection, centroid width 4097, selected width 4097, hidden width 1025, strided inputs, signed/unsigned ordering, F32/F16/BF16 and mixed weights, and empty batch/sequence. Independent scalar output and each retained output allocation are checked.

Uneven sequence chunks of 1, 3 and 4 positions compare with a full seven-position two-batch invocation for each of 20 dtype/layout/index configurations. CPU multi-row parity checks distinct position minima.
Architecture-level neutral traces execute three assistant draft steps for both ordinary and ordered-embedding readout; ordered traces carry the actual hidden, weight, centroid and ordering geometry.
limits: Operation and assistant equation traces do not complete public request admission, independent expert residency schedules, paging/materialization/transfers, TP/PP/prediction composition, retained captures or branch/copy accounting.
Native facts bound managed tensor buffers and disjoint host numerical payload, not total process memory, driver metadata, allocator cache, program caches or unrelated work.

Native validation uses the selected Metal realization and a CPU regression. No new released-checkpoint or native distributed experiment was performed; the recorded Qwen checkpoint experiment remains separate.
Centroid tie-selection policy is unchanged; this fixture uses distinct centroid scores to isolate projection and mask-floor semantics.
Existing large-unwind linker and unused internal helper/quote warnings remain.

checks.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -p eredu-backend-mlx --features metal --lib -- masked_ --include-ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture
